tailoring.headline: Tech Lead – Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years e-commerce integration expertise
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering large-scale e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, micro-services and headless OCC REST APIs, designing and implementing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, data pipelines and API migrations. Proven track record leading technical teams, conducting code reviews, and supporting production in Agile environments. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes and AI-assisted development, bridging business and IT to drive robust commerce solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Jansi Rani Velmurugan’s vision to advance its Salesforce Commerce Cloud platform, and I see a strong fit with my 5+ years of leading SAP Commerce Cloud projects for Rockwell Automation and Shell. My deep experience in headless e-commerce APIs, large-scale integrations and agile delivery equips me to drive your SFCC initiatives forward.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Led design and implementation of OCC REST APIs and data pipelines that synchronized product data across PIM, ERP and MDM systems, ensuring reliable headless commerce interfaces.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Provided technical guidance, performed code reviews and mentored junior developers, fostering high-quality delivery in cross-functional Agile teams.

bullets.label: Performance & Scalability
bullets.text: Refactored complex FlexibleSearch queries and optimized database performance, reducing response times and supporting high-traffic e-commerce workloads.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Deployments
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, enabling rapid, reliable releases.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Jansi Rani Velmurugan’s commitment to building a best-in-class Salesforce Commerce Cloud experience aligns with my passion for creating scalable, headless e-commerce solutions. I am impressed by the company’s focus on innovative digital commerce and its international client base, and I want to apply my proven integration and API expertise to help accelerate your SFCC roadmap and deliver measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to lead your SFCC transformation, leveraging my 5+ years of e-commerce platform expertise to deliver robust, scalable solutions that drive growth.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale e-commerce integrations. I’m eager to bring my API and integration expertise to your Tech Lead – SFCC role. Could we discuss?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will apply my proven SAP Commerce Cloud integration experience to design and implement robust headless APIs for your SFCC platform, and establish efficient CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable releases. My background in PIM/ERP data pipelines and production support will ensure seamless migration and high availability.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Tech Lead – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior e-commerce developer with over five years of experience on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am impressed by Jansi Rani Velmurugan’s ambition to expand its Salesforce Commerce Cloud capabilities and believe my expertise in headless APIs, large-scale integrations and agile delivery can accelerate your roadmap. I can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.
